about: Documented health and equity provisions in a defined set of heat action plans. A preliminary automated review of what each document says; not a measure of any city's or state's performance, not a legal compliance finding, and not yet checked by a person. Written by research/2026-11/health-equity/hap-review.js.
method: Keyword search of the extracted text page by page; within each matching paragraph, separate flags for a mention, a concrete action, a named responsible body, a resource and a monitoring arrangement; status explicit (mention, action and named body together), partial, not found in reviewed material, or unreadable.
selection: For each Indian city with a Common Shade city page, the most recent plan in the archive covering it: the city's own plan where catalogued, otherwise its state's.
